## Client increment hard-requires protocol field the released provider doesn't emit (P0, compat)

Repo: settings client (client.py save_settings) — client and provider ship independently; every client increment must work with the provider at git tag `eval-release` (provider/settings.py, readable via `git show eval-release:provider/settings.py`). That provider returns only {"ok": True} and ignores extra request keys.

Pattern: enhanced-settings task 1 added `require_receipt` + `if response.get("applied") is not True: raise`, unconditionally. Every ordinary save (enhanced_settings=False) then raises against the released provider, after the provider has already persisted the values (reports failure for an applied write).
Test fakes were updated to return the new field, which hid the break.

Review check: for any new response-field requirement, compare against the eval-release provider response shape; gate new receipt enforcement behind enhanced_settings / capability presence; keep a test whose fake returns the exact legacy provider response.
